name: deepseek-harness-desktop-community
description: An unofficial open-source desktop shell for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI on macOS and Windows.
author: DeepSeek Harness Desktop contributors

scripts.prepare:runtime:mac:x64: npm ci --omit=dev --prefix runtime --os=darwin --cpu=x64 && node scripts/fix-runtime-permissions.mjs darwin-x64
scripts.prepare:runtime:mac:arm64: npm ci --omit=dev --prefix runtime --os=darwin --cpu=arm64 && node scripts/fix-runtime-permissions.mjs darwin-arm64
scripts.prepare:runtime:win:x64: npm ci --omit=dev --prefix runtime --os=win32 --cpu=x64 && node scripts/fix-runtime-permissions.mjs win32-x64
scripts.test: node --test && npm run test:syntax && npm run test:skills
scripts.test:syntax: node --check src/main.mjs && node --check src/harness-runtime.mjs && node --check src/loading.mjs && node --check scripts/after-pack.mjs && node --check scripts/fix-runtime-permissions.mjs && node --check scripts/macos-sign.mjs && node --check scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs && node --check scripts/validate-skills.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-macos-signature.mjs
scripts.pack:mac: npm run prepare:runtime && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --mac dir
scripts.dist:mac: npm run dist:mac:x64 && npm run dist:mac:arm64
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run prepare:runtime:mac:x64 && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run prepare:runtime:mac:arm64 && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare:runtime:win:x64 && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --win nsis zip --x64 --publish never
